description: Canales de riego is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Nacional de Riego. Canales de riego a nivel de matrices hasta 2 derivado para todo el País. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Nacional de Riego. Its tags are canales, cnr, ide minagri, matrices, riego. The portal shows 2015-10-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
